_comment: Per-machine config. Copy to ~/.claude/anytype/config.json, fill in, chmod 600. NEVER commit the real file (it holds api_key).
_api_base_note: Mac desktop app = http://localhost:31009/v1 ; headless anytype-cli = http://localhost:31012/v1
_api_key_note: Mac: Anytype Settings -> API Keys. Headless: `anytype auth apikey create <name>` (NOT the account key from `auth create`).
_skills_ns_note: MUST be unique per machine or machines fight over the same skills namespace. In use: mac, ccabuc, xzabu. A 2nd Mac must NOT reuse 'mac' (e.g. macm2).
_memory_dirs_note: Key '' (main) is REQUIRED on every node (shared base; omitting it makes reconcile del_remote the bare-name pages from the authority). Add one entry per namespace this machine owns. To DOWNLOAD-but-not-recall another ns (e.g. jgb on a non-jgb box), point it at a non-project sink dir like /home/<user>/.claude/anytype/mirror-jgb.
